supplements.anchor: Unchanged initial design; this profile specifies compatible wire encoding

configuration: Exactly one engine_configuration ArtifactRef with causalbank.tetrad-config/1.0.0 schema and verified bytes. Keep alpha, depth, missingness, shrinkage, knowledge and numeric settings there; do not add fields to generic parameters.
request_identity: The immutable configuration hash is included among request input identities. Changing any setting changes full request identity even when scientific_context is unchanged.
admission: Resolver checks required roles, registered per-role schemas, no duplicate configuration and reviewed engine/profile mapping. Generic JSON-schema validation alone does not perform these checks.

evidence.anchor: Four validated examples, no actual Java

limits: Deterministic data fixture is not an IID statistical sample.
Illustrative computed graph is an independent population reference, not a fit of the fixture or engine output.
No runtime admission or new endpoint implemented.
